integrity: The facet list is replayed exactly. A concrete integral one-cocycle is checked on every triangular face and every nonfacial triangle; exhaustive symmetry search is restricted only by the provably invariant antipodal missing-edge matching. Published topology supplies H1=Z.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the labelled centrally symmetric twelve-vertex S3 x S1 triangulation. The common positive sign depends on the displayed orientation convention; the basis-free statement is common primitivity. Longer representatives and other sphere-product triangulations are not classified.
title: Forty coherently oriented triangular generators in the twelve-vertex \(S^3\times S^1\)
